name: Virtual Staging AI
summary: One-click virtual staging for real-estate photos, including furniture removal, with a turnaround the site puts at about 10 seconds.
description: One-click virtual staging for real-estate photos, including furniture removal, with a turnaround the site puts at about 10 seconds.

pricing.details: Monthly and yearly show the same effective monthly rate (yearly is 12 monthly payments). Basic 14 €/month, or 174 €/year — 6 photos/month. Standard 17 €/month, or 206 €/year — 20 photos/month, image storage forever. Professional 35 €/month, or 423 €/year — 60 photos/month, image storage forever, success manager. Enterprise 71 €/month, or 858 €/year — 150 photos/month, API access, image storage forever, enterprise support with a success manager. A free image-editing trial is included on the paid plans; no permanent free staging plan is published.
pricing.label: Premium

features: One-click virtual staging for real-estate photos, including furniture removal, with an official turnaround of about 10 seconds
Unlimited renders and downloads, all standard room types and styles, no watermark
Basic, Standard, Professional and Enterprise, with the same monthly rate billed monthly or yearly (12×)
A free image-editing trial is included; there is no permanent free staging plan.
